rawUserRequest: 周报验收反馈指出来源可用性被误当作 Evidence，要求优先修复 SEC ingestion，加入 document discovery、Claim Extraction Gate，并重构 Weekly Radar 证据语义。用户同意开始，并授权执行到 WI 全部流程结束、触发一次 CI。

rawRequestSource.reference: Current conversation: review approval and explicit execution/CI authorization.

problemStatement: Weekly Radar currently promotes reachable official pages to confirmed facts, so the report confirms source availability rather than enterprise production-system change. SEC collection also fails as one opaque unit and does not provide a document-discovery path. The requested product impact is to separate availability, leads, validated facts, and structural evidence while preserving calibrated no-change and fail-closed ranking behavior.

scenarioCoverage.scenario: SEC submissions and Company Facts succeed with bounded filing/document discovery.
scenarioCoverage.expected: SEC facts remain confirmed, recent filing candidates retain source/date/accession provenance, and finite response/User-Agent limits remain enforced.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Run fixture-backed SEC success, filing discovery, User-Agent, response-limit, and all-ten-company coverage tests.

scenarioCoverage.scenario: A single SEC endpoint failure is diagnosable without discarding independent successful results.
scenarioCoverage.expected: The report records a safe endpoint-scoped failure; available facts or documents remain retained; no response body or provider-auth material is exposed.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Run submissions-only and facts-only fixture failures and assert partial result, coverage, and redacted failure text.

scenarioCoverage.scenario: Official homepages produce source availability and document candidates, not confirmed evidence.
scenarioCoverage.expected: Bounded same-origin links are discovered; homepage text alone cannot enter Confirmed Information or satisfy has_primary_evidence.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Run same-origin, cross-origin, deduplication, request-limit, homepage-only, and source-status tests.

scenarioCoverage.scenario: Claim Extraction Gate rejects incomplete or unsupported claims and promotes only ValidatedEvidence.
scenarioCoverage.expected: Missing subject/change/date/production-area/source/cutoff/authority remains pending or unknown; complete authoritative candidates become confirmed facts with provenance.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Run table-driven acceptance/rejection fixtures and assert deterministic reason, polarity, date, source, and content-hash retention.

scenarioCoverage.scenario: Weekly Radar reports availability, leads, validated evidence, and unavailable sources separately in all languages.
scenarioCoverage.expected: Confirmed Information contains only validated facts; degraded coverage is stated as data insufficiency rather than no-change proof; Chinese, Japanese, and English render deterministically.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Run localized renderer fixtures, legacy snapshot decoding, counter assertions, and no-ranking assertions.

scenarioCoverage.scenario: Existing Stage-before-Ranking and publication fail-closed gates remain unchanged.
scenarioCoverage.expected: Insufficient validated evidence emits no machine Ranking and a source page cannot satisfy the primary-evidence publication guard.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Run existing judgment-chain tests plus new homepage-only and pending-candidate CLI fixtures.

riskAssessment.reason: This changes the source-to-confirmed-evidence boundary, SEC failure handling, and report counters while preserving immutable snapshots. The scope is explicit and fixtures verify the gate without external provider values.
riskAssessment.reviewNotes: The historical SEC all-unavailable root cause is not inferred without run logs; implementation will add endpoint-specific evidence and fixtures instead.

checkpointPolicy.reason: Keep cross-boundary evidence semantics and verification obligations bound during implementation and Finish.

acceptance: SEC acquisition exposes bounded submissions, Company Facts, and recent filing/document provenance with endpoint-scoped safe failures; successful independent SEC facts are retained when an optional document request fails.
Official IR, careers, and engineering entry points perform bounded same-origin document discovery with stable deduplication, date/provenance retention, no guessed URLs, and no unrestricted crawl.

An explicit EvidenceCandidate-to-ValidatedEvidence gate requires subject, concrete change/fact, usable date, production-system area, source identity/type, authority, cutoff, and provenance before a record can be confirmed.

Page-level SourceObservation and discovery-only material cannot become Confirmed Information or satisfy has_primary_evidence; validated evidence and structured SEC facts retain the existing fail-closed judgment boundary.

Weekly Radar separates validated evidence, source availability, pending leads, and unavailable sources in the snapshot and Chinese/Japanese/English report output; degraded coverage is not rendered as proof of no change.

Focused tests cover SEC success/partial failure, discovery bounds, claim-gate rejection/promotion, source semantics, localized report counters, legacy snapshot compatibility, and unchanged Stage/Ranking suppression.
The final verification record contains each required local gate result, exact-branch hosted CI result, and the clean lifecycle audit for this Work Item.
guidelines: Keep provider-specific payload models inside runtime adapters and keep Stage/Ranking provider-agnostic.

Use finite request counts, response limits, same-origin checks, deterministic ordering, and safe diagnostics; never retain provider-auth material, headers, response bodies, or guessed URLs in evidence.
Treat source availability, document discovery, candidate extraction, and validated evidence as distinct states; do not use a page-level observation as a claim.
Preserve UNKNOWN versus UNAVAILABLE semantics and calibrated no-change wording.
Document new public APIs and do not add dependencies unless the Contract is amended and revalidated.
Resolve defects within this Work Item when they remain in scope; do not create a successor merely to avoid an in-scope correction.

rollbackNote: Revert this Work Item diff and restore the isolated SEC, source, evidence, report, tests, documentation, and governance records; historical published snapshots are not rewritten.

intent.problem: ORG-X can report reachable official pages as confirmed information even when no enterprise change claim was extracted. The Weekly Radar pipeline runs but has insufficient research value, and the SEC all-unavailable result is not actionable enough to distinguish endpoint failure from missing data.
constraints: Prioritize SEC recovery, then bounded document discovery and claim validation; keep Ranking and Stage fail-closed.
Do not infer a root cause for the historical SEC failure without run evidence; expose safe endpoint-level diagnostics and test fixtures instead.
Preserve immutable snapshots and localized output contracts, with explicit defaults for legacy inputs.
Use no new external integration state, LLM, or unrestricted crawler.
intent.rationale: One vertical Work Item is necessary because source semantics, evidence promotion, primary-evidence gating, and report counters must change together to avoid a misleading intermediate state.
